scope: Prospective cost of correcting compatible mass. F32 compact one-worker internal fixtures at common NashConv targets; numerical correctness is established by independent tests, not historical state equality. Not external reference or full R1 acceptance.

target_derivation.rule: For each case use block1 new/prepared-kernel original report from the committed prior campaign. Round its nonnegative NashConv upward to three significant decimal digits; exact zero stays zero. Freeze before candidate observations. No target, cap or cadence adjustment afterward.
target_derivation.metric: NashConv = (BR0-EV0)+(BR1-EV1), unclamped. NC/2 is only the conventional two-player zero-sum exploitability interpretation; general-sum/raked games retain NashConv semantics.

order: Cases river, turn, flop, narrow-river. Blocks0..3; block0 warmup. Old first iff (case-index+block) even, otherwise new first. 32 processes,24 measured; six measured pairs per order across cases. No pilot, retry, replacement or post-candidate adjustment.
correctness: Every process must reach the same case target within cap with finite EV/BR/NashConv. Repeated runs within each arm must reproduce iterations, quality and original canonical/state bytes exactly. Old/new must match normalized config, algorithm, rake, utility, global hands, counts and exact normalizer f64 bits, plus raw common topology/root-weight/deal headers with only iteration count omitted. Old/new values and raw state hashes may differ and are reported. Any mismatch, target miss or process failure stops and skips the remainder with no cost guard.
measurement: Same Linux x86_64 boot,4logical CPUs/full affinity/quota>=4, one Rayon worker, <=12GiB cgroup and swap0. Separate old/new fresh release builds; old build-only and new full validation. Timed run includes solve chunks plus all periodic exact EV/BR checks through first passing check or cap; final report evaluation, construction and artifact capture are outside. No concurrent build/transfer. Native wait4 RSS and sampled process-tree RSS are separate full-process metrics, not solve-only; inherited pre-exec high-water may floor native RSS. No memory non-regression claim from these metrics. Tiny cases and three pairs are descriptive; cost ceiling is not a speedup claim.
retention: Original-byte CAS uses the frozen showdown runner Store payload schema only. New plan/result/verification semantics are exact-mass. Trusted local helper code is pinned and imported from the checkout, never from evidence. Retain sources/manifests, binaries/build proofs, controls/reference originals, every raw process log/sample/report/artifact; compiler/Python identity-only. Source-after is recorded live rehash, not independent filesystem snapshot.
failure: No retries. Each process<=300s with >=320s remaining, sampled RSS<=10GiB/free>=1GiB/disk>=4GiB; outer service enforces deadline. Failed prepare is terminal. Target miss retains its complete diagnostic report and remaining stages are skipped; no timing adoption guard. All counts/thresholds fixed before candidate runs.
